framing: Deterministic checks over method artifacts. This is the mechanical half of the Critic. It objects to nothing, scores nothing, admits nothing and parks nothing. A written attack is soften-critic's turn and is never auto-served.

checks.title: rule and control are compared at matched exposure
checks.detail: the bar declares a matched-exposure or per-bet contrast

evidence.contrast: d_i = pnl_rule_fee_adj_i - pnl_baseline_fee_adj_i on the same n windows

matched_exposure.detail: the rule arm risks (1 - skip_rate) * n * $1 against the baseline's n * $1; the raw contrast measures volume as well as selection
matched_exposure.control: permutation null holding the number of skips fixed and reassigning which windows are skipped
matched_exposure.requirement: observed mean(d) must exceed the (1 - alpha_k) quantile of that null, in addition to clauses (1), (3) and (4)
matched_exposure.why: converts the question from 'did abstaining help?' to 'did this abstention rule beat abstaining at the same rate?'
also_report: mean(d) per dollar at risk beside mean(d) per window
skip_rate * mean(fee | skip) — the mechanical fee-avoidance component of the contrast

checks.title: effect floor is not merely the detection floor
checks.detail: delta 0.28 vs MDE 0.1837 at n=70 (ratio 1.525). delta is more than 10% above the floor
